purpose: Demonstrate unattended Skyrim VR startup, scene loading, resolved CSX profiling, and exact submitted-eye capture through SteamVR's synthetic null HMD.

sourceSnapshot.buildConfiguration: VR Release; DEVBENCH_BRIDGE=ON; AUTO_PLUGIN_DEPLOYMENT=OFF; full AIO staged from the source snapshot

dependencies.name: CommonLibSSE-NG
dependencies.notes: Revision and clean state verified directly in the submodule after the run. The rebuilt DLL's embedded build metadata reported unknown, so this Git provenance closes that metadata gap.

runtimeLane.notes: The game loaded the vanilla openvr_api.dll. OCU was disabled. Virtual Desktop's SteamVR driver also loaded, but the SteamVR null driver owned the active HMD. This lane provides no OCU or OpenXR evidence.

hmd.profile: CSX Null HMD POC; 1512x1680 per eye; 90 Hz; IPD 0.063 m; forcedDriver=null; requireHmd=false

scene.poseScript: SteamVR null-driver fixed HMD pose; no controller input; camera observed at [-36.0, -115.99998, 98.61119], yaw -0.083826
controlledVariables: Settled save loaded through DevBench loadLast
CSX AMD Quality settings with Developer Mode enabled only for capture
Profiler and screenshot capture executed as separate passes

issues: This sample proves profiler resolution only; it is not a sufficiently repeated preset-performance benchmark.
The top-level resolved total is a final snapshot, while the Upscaling distribution contains eight history samples.
The six-compositor-cycle interval was too aggressive for lossless stereo PNG encoding and caused eight backpressure rejections.
All three requested pairs nevertheless completed successfully at compositor cycle tokens 6274, 6280, and 6334.

artifacts.role: Exact CSX settings used by the test profile
Derived side-by-side stereo image for inspection
Identity record for the completed branch-matched Debug shader cache

controlledVariables: One save, scene, and static driver pose
deviations: Virtual Desktop's SteamVR driver was resident even though the null driver owned the HMD.
The capture cadence caused queue backpressure and must be increased for the next run.

reasons: Eight queue-backpressure drops violate the first-proof-of-concept acceptance gate.
Fixed-pose repeatability has been demonstrated once but not yet quantified across repeated starts.
Profiler output is sufficient to prove the endpoint but not to support a preset comparison.

conclusions: SteamVR's built-in null HMD can run this Skyrim VR, DevBench, CSX profiler, and exact stereo capture path without an occupied physical HMD.
A live physical Virtual Desktop headset did not prevent the null driver from owning the active HMD during this run.
The three captured eye pairs are visually complete and show coherent left/right parallax without an obvious duplicated-eye failure.
The next capture should use a substantially larger compositor-cycle interval before the lane is accepted for benchmark work.
This native OpenVR result says nothing about OCU, SteamVR OpenXR, or VDXR equivalence.
notes: IBL 1.1.3 loaded successfully. CSX accepted the disk cache and selectively rebuilt content-digest changes in 90 seconds before DataLoaded.

The completed Debug cache was preserved as the MO2 mod Community Shaders VR Shader Cache - CSX3.18-f971c9122-Debug; its Info.ini SHA-256 is 1B4604FB8AF6C66A06DA9FE213791F30DB03FA2AA769833F5D1CE5F27466680E.
Temporary SteamVR and MO2 configuration changes were restored byte-for-byte after the run.
